hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | (read file_path; if [ -n "$file_path" ] && echo "$file_path" | grep -qE '^.*/iron-spot/(ios|android)/'; then echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"Do not edit ios/ or android/ directories — Expo managed workflow. Use app.json or app.config.ts instead."}'; fi)

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | (read file_path; if [ -n "$file_path" ] && echo "$file_path" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|json|md)$' && [ -f "$(dirname "$(pwd)")/iron-spot/node_modules/.bin/prettier" ]; then cd /Users/yj-you/Desktop/personal/development/project/iron-spot && pnpm exec prettier --write "$file_path" 2>/dev/null || true; fi)

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | (read file_path; if [ -n "$file_path" ] && echo "$file_path" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx)$' && [ -f "/Users/yj-you/Desktop/personal/development/project/iron-spot/tsconfig.json" ]; then cd /Users/yj-you/Desktop/personal/development/project/iron-spot && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -30 || true; fi)

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | (read file_path; if [ -n "$file_path" ] && echo "$file_path" | grep -qE '/src/.*\.(ts|tsx)$' && ! echo "$file_path" | grep -qE '\.test\.(ts|tsx)$' && [ -f "/Users/yj-you/Desktop/personal/development/project/iron-spot/jest.config.js" ]; then cd /Users/yj-you/Desktop/personal/development/project/iron-spot && test_dir="$(dirname "$file_path")/__tests__"; base_name="$(basename "$file_path" | sed -E 's/\.(ts|tsx)$//')"; test_file="$test_dir/$base_name.test.ts"; [ ! -f "$test_file" ] && test_file="$test_dir/$base_name.test.tsx"; if [ -f "$test_file" ]; then pnpm exec jest "$test_file" --silent 2>&1 | tail -10 || true; fi; fi)
